description: Frozen multiplex direct-neighbor requests. Complete requests ask for the unique union; bounded requests select a canonical-ID prefix with complete selected-layer supports for every returned row. Source weights remain separate. Four variants per selection and direction are independent of graph outcomes and generation budgets. No language model runs at build time.
